question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT '2020-01-31' as month_end, 1 as month_num
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-02-29', 2
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03-31', 3
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04-30', 4
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        m.month_end,
        m.month_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type IN ('withdrawal', 'purchase') THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as closing_balance
    FROM months m
    CROSS JOIN customers c
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id AND ct.txn_date <= m.month_end
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.month_end, m.month_num
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_end,
    closing_balance,
    closing_balance - LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_num) as monthly_change,
    closing_balance as cumulative_balance
FROM customer_month_balance
ORDER BY customer_id, month_num
